scientific_snapshot.verification_scope: only actual source members; no whole-archive rehash

canonical_features.binding_method: opaque streaming digest; content not parsed in Stage A

canonical_baseline_predictions.binding_method: opaque streaming digest; content not parsed in Stage A

canonical_baseline_metrics.binding_method: opaque streaming digest; content not parsed in Stage A

family_membership.binding_method: opaque streaming digest; content not parsed in Stage A

family_predictions.binding_method: opaque streaming digest; content not parsed in Stage A

run_external_fold_models.py.role: static source reference; never imported by the new runner

common.py.role: static source reference; never imported by the new runner

execution.results_policy: new absolute child directory of experiment_root/results; reject existing path
execution.restart_policy: no automatic resume/refit; retain failed evidence

e1.uncertain_groups: three frozen groups; seven members retain member-specific strict keys
e1.row_index: zero-based physical clean_cond row, never parquet_row
e1.membership: fixed original train/test/neither from canonical membership; no rebuilding or test exclusion
e1.parent_deletion: delete original train if its host parent is in test host parents OR guest parent is in test guest parents

random_deletion.size: exact number removed by same-block parent purge

e1.target_gate: check at Stage B, after frozen masks; no drop or replacement of invalid blocks
e1.input_precision: retain original NPZ array dtypes and original scoring target dtype; no implicit casts
e1.all_nulls_refit_or_recomputed: own arm training rows, own additive mean and own k5 library; never use saved null scores
e1.guarded_r2: target has at least two distinct values and prediction std > 1e-9; finite r2 required
e1.best_null: maximum finite eligible guarded R2 among exactly the same six nulls; no eligible null means undefined
e1.standard_auxiliary: standard R2 including constant predictions, same six nulls; no extra mean-prediction model
e1.margin: PAIR_RF R2 minus same-arm best-null R2
e1.aggregate: all 12 blocks equal weight; any undefined block makes the corresponding arm mean undefined
e1.primary_contrast: parent-purge equal-block margin mean minus mean of three random-purge equal-block margin means
e1.secondary_contrast: parent-purge equal-block margin mean minus baseline equal-block margin mean
e1.baseline_check: all original baseline blocks before intervention fits; exact keys and saved target strings, finite numeric differences <= 8*ulp(reference); unexplained mismatch stops E1
e1.report: all blocks/arms, absolute RF and six-null metrics, MAE, guarded/standard margins, deletion share and remaining exposure; first formal block time and process peak memory
e1.inference: descriptive; no p value/CI; overlapping blocks and random masks are not independent chemical replicates

e2.panel: all membership-selected records; require one prediction per model per row, aligned raw host/guest and target
e2.target_matching: exact float64 equality or exact source float32 round trip, no broad tolerance
e2.rank_definition: average-tie global ranks for each target and prediction vector on all 352 records
e2.check: between+within equals pooled Spearman and separately scipy.stats.spearmanr
e2.primary_contrast: PAIR_RF signed within contribution minus guest_only_RF signed within contribution
e2.secondary_eligibility: at least five distinct raw guests and both host-local Spearman values defined
e2.secondary_weight: eligible raw hosts equally weighted, paired model rho difference
e2.support_table: all 21 hosts including ineligible, distinct guest counts, ties, constant predictions/targets and undefined reasons
e2.no_inference: no p values/CI; test-host centering is a decomposition, not calibration

prohibitions: no MSE decomposition, pair averaging or 17-model scan
no edits to the fixed snapshot or historical files
post_freeze_bug_policy: retain prior code and reason, targeted repair only; frozen masks/rules may not be silently changed

public_path_binding.source_path_semantics: path is relative to its declared scope root; the adapter resolves it at runtime
public_path_binding.historical_static_sources: not redistributed; never imported by the E1/E2 runners
